question: Why did the catechol purity at the column top fall when the operating pressure of the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation was lowered from 20 to 5 kPa?

Document title: "Rigorous Modeling and Industrial-Scalable Optimization of Hydroquinone-Catechol Vacuum Distillation: Aspen Plus-RSM Integration for Thermally Labile Systems"

The catechol purity at the column top fell when the operating pressure of the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation was lowered from 20 to 5 kPa because at lower pressures, the elevated temperatures at the column top enhanced the volatility of the heavy component (hydroquinone), leading to its increased presence in the overhead product and a corresponding decrease in catechol purity.
